title: Investigation into Case Involving Expectant Mother Losing Her Child after Being Allegedly Left Unattended at Emergency Department of NUH
what_it_is: Investigation into Case Involving Expectant Mother Losing Her Child after Being Allegedly Left Unattended at Emergency Department of NUH

sections.label: Couple and NUH discussions closed
sections.summary: The couple discussed the matter with the NUH team, and it has been closed between the two parties.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The couple has had discussions with the NUH team and the matter has since been closed between the two parties.

sections.label: NUH investigation and process review
sections.summary: NUH investigated thoroughly and reviewed processes with MOH and the Director of Medical Services, finding clinical care appropriate but communication and transfer coordination improvable.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: NUH has investigated the matter thoroughly and reviewed their processes, in consultation with the Ministry of Health (MOH) and the Director of Medical Services.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Their clinical care processes are appropriate, but there were some areas for improved communications and the coordination for transfers between the ED and the Delivery Suite.

sections.label: NUH communication improvements instituted
sections.summary: NUH recognised ways to improve communication and information provision, and has instituted process changes for timely, more acceptable information to patients and families.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Notwithstanding the findings that the clinical care processes were appropriate and not contributing to the outcome, the NUH team did, indeed, look through how they performed their communication, how they provided the information that was available to reassure and inform the couple.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: And, indeed, there were ways in which they could improve that, they recognised this and they have already instituted changes to the processes to make sure that information is provided in a timely manner and done so in a way that is more acceptable to the patients and their families.

sections.label: Investigating allegations and supporting healthcare workers
sections.summary: Allegations must be investigated as duty to patients, and quick thorough fact-finding involving the healthcare worker is the best protection, with counselling and psychological support available.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: If you are potentially the healthcare worker involved, you worry about the care that you delivered, whether you have made an error, whether your team has allowed something to happen, when the allegation is made.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: However, all of these allegations and comments do need to be investigated.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: I think we should not take the view that somehow, we should not look into them.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We must investigate the process because that is our duty to the patients and the families that we care for.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: And the best protection then for healthcare workers is quick and thorough establishing of the facts that are involved and to do so in a way that involves the healthcare worker, systematically and professionally.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Nevertheless, it can be taxing and draining on the healthcare workers who are involved, and we have services that are available for counselling and psychological support for the healthcare workers that are within the system and are working in these situations.
